title: A little flour, a lot of love.
excerpt: Sunday afternoons are for slow cooking, flour-dusted countertops, and homemade pasta. Come pull up a chair.
body:
There’s something lovely about making a meal with your hands. Today, we’re slowing down and making fresh pasta.

For a small batch, start with 200g of flour and two large eggs. Make a well in the flour, add the eggs, and gently bring everything together with a fork. Knead until smooth, then cover and rest for 30 minutes.

Roll the dough thin, cut into ribbons, and cook in well-salted boiling water until tender. Toss with your favorite sauce and a little pasta water. Finish with Parmesan, fresh basil, and a seat at the table.
